description: The user's training blocks with their dates, goals and how many weeks each runs. The ones covering today also carry week_of_total ('3/16'), so an answer can say which week of the block they are in. Use when the user asks what they are working on, before adding a block (to see what is already there), or to review a block against its goal with get_training_log. All dates are the user's local calendar dates (YYYY-MM-DD) in their own time zone. Requires signing in.

when.description: Which blocks: covering today, starting later, already finished, or all. Default 'all'.

name: get_blocks
title: Read the training blocks
